evidence.fact: before_agent_start exposes prompt/images/systemPrompt; context returns messages; before_provider_request handles an unknown provider-specific payload.
context runs against a cloned message view. Modified per-call messages are marked, not written into original session history. This seam cannot change the toolset or systemPrompt.
agent_end.willContinue means a continuation is already scheduled and is not a user-visible terminal settle.
agent_end notification is detached. before_agent_start also runs for automatic continuations; it cannot alone identify a new human turn.
A before_agent_start custom message is persisted. This is not the selected injection mechanism because it adds a message and has provider-dependent developer-role mapping.
Existing host pattern freezes per-user-message text with a persistent anchor derived from role/timestamp/pre-injection content hash.
The existing project extension uses persistent user-message anchors for contextual injection. Reuse the behavior pattern; do not edit the Trellis extension.
Root/subagent filtering uses sessionFile and parentSession layout, not parentSession alone. Skip unclassifiable in-memory sessions and willContinue notifications.

Project/user extension discovery supports disabledExtensions capability IDs; configured extension names are matched as extension-module:<name>. Existing settings and unrelated extensions must be preserved.
HINDSIGHT_AUTO_RECALL and HINDSIGHT_AUTO_RETAIN override project settings. mentalModelsEnabled is read from settings. Do not assume a YAML false defeats an environment override.

adapterDecision.capture: agent_end with willContinue false, root-only, original user/assistant text on the active branch. Atomically persist a durable outbox entry before network delivery. Replay only enabled authorized project entries; acknowledgements advance durable state.
adapterDecision.recallPreparation: Use a bounded pre-turn request without cloud inference. before_agent_start may stage the result, but a stage is not permission to inject: bind it only to the matching new genuine user-message anchor.
adapterDecision.injection: context applies a frozen snapshot in the user-message data view. Reapply prior persisted anchors identically; create an anchor only for the actual new human message. Never add a transient tail message or rewrite provider-specific payloads.
adapterDecision.emptySnapshot: Persist explicit empty/timeout anchor outcomes too. Otherwise service recovery during a tool follow-up could insert new text into an already-sent user message.
adapterDecision.storage: Anchor snapshots and capture delivery state are separate concerns with protected local files. Original session text remains unchanged. Never collect the anchor/recall view as new evidence.
adapterDecision.cutover: At a fresh project session boundary, preserve task role bindings and configure hindsight.autoRecall:false, hindsight.autoRetain:false, hindsight.mentalModelsEnabled:false. Disable the existing jev-memory-gate extension for this project to prevent optional Seam B ownership. Verify effective settings/environment; if another automatic owner remains enabled, refuse SiYuan activation rather than run both. Do not erase Hindsight data or alter unrelated projects.

smokeBoundary.isolation: Use a separate PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR and session directory; do not copy the native live auth/database. Explicit extension loading with --no-extensions avoids unrelated global extensions.
smokeBoundary.loadOnly: omp models --json -e <adapter> --no-extensions can exercise real loading without a generation request; this does not prove capture or recall.
smokeBoundary.endToEnd: Run actual persisted sandboxed OMP conversations with the approved synthetic cloud-provider setup, then verify real service ingestion/SiYuan output and outgoing recall context. Do NOT pass --no-session for capture proof: unclassifiable in-memory sessions are intentionally skipped.
